env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
# A fork-only standard-library selector has no upstream spelling
# (SPEC T-0.3): logos build accepts it, but logos eject must refuse it
# at its source location instead of reporting a successful eject.
# The direct EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect call is exempt: eject rewrites it
# to the ejectedhttp.RequireExtendedConnect helper form
# (see logos_eject_h2extendedconnect). This case keeps a method value,
# which no rewrite covers, so eject must still refuse it here.
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:6.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../expression
# A method expression likewise has no upstream spelling and no rewrite.
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:5.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../samename
# A file that declares the method name itself is skipped by the eject
# rewrite, so verification must refuse even the genuine server call in
# it instead of exempting it by type.
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../ok
# The stock-library control ejects cleanly.
logos build ./...
logos eject -o out
exists out/server.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/h2portability

go 1.27

-- m/server.lgo --
package h2portability

import "net/http"

func Enable(s *http.Server) {
	f := s.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect
	_ = f
}

-- ok/go.mod --
module example.com/h2ok

go 1.27

-- ok/server.lgo --
package h2ok

import "net/http"

func KeepAlive(s *http.Server) {
	s.SetKeepAlivesEnabled(true)
}

-- expression/go.mod --
module example.com/h2expression

go 1.27

-- expression/server.lgo --
package h2expression

import "net/http"

var Enable = (*http.Server).EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect

-- samename/go.mod --
module example.com/h2samename

go 1.27

-- samename/server.lgo --
package h2samename

import "net/http"

type Mine struct{}

func (Mine) EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect() {}

func Enable(s *http.Server) {
	s.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	var m Mine
	m.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
}
